# E2E support (e2e)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: none yet.

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Helpers every spec in `apps/e2e/tests` uses: sign-in and session steps, page locators, fake media API, PNG and TOTP generators, mail code lookup, smoke database seeding, and the apps' own constants re-exported for the tests.

## Techniques

`Apps.contract.ts` imports the apps' real routes, copy and limits so tests break when the apps change. Env is read once (`E2e.env.ts`). CSP violations are watched from the console (`watchCsp`). Mail codes come from the Mailpit API.

## Technologies

Playwright (Chromium), `otplib`, Node.js `zlib` and `child_process`.

## Entry points

Imported by the specs in `apps/e2e/tests/*.e2e.spec.ts`; run with `pnpm e2e:spec` against a running stack.

## Where to change what

A new spec in `tests/*.e2e.spec.ts` carries `{ tag: [...] }` on its top-level `test.describe` (a file of bare tests is wrapped in one): an app tag for every app it exercises (`@cms-admin`, `@web`, `@cms-api`; `@cms-api` on every spec that sends a request to cms-api, through a page or directly) and one `@<flow>` per flow in `docs/flows/` it walks (an app-wide spec has no flow tag). `SpecTags.contract.test.ts` (tier 1, in `test:unit`) fails, naming the file and tag, when a tag option has no app tag or a tag names no folder of `docs/apps/` or `docs/flows/`. `*.contract.spec.ts` files get no tag. Select by tag with `pnpm e2e:spec --grep @<flow>`.

A helper used by two or more specs goes here; one spec's helper stays in the spec. App constants come only through `Apps.contract.ts`, never copied.
